stem.en: With no arrow, Japan is the nearest word to Tokyo, at 0.68. With the Paris-to-France arrow added, Japan is still top, at 0.81. What did the arrow do?

text.en: It found Japan, which Tokyo could not reach
It raised the closeness of Japan to the sum
It taught the model that Tokyo is in Japan

explanation.en: Japan was already top with no arrow, so the start word chose it. The arrow only lifted its closeness from 0.68 to 0.81. A sum changes no setting, so it teaches the model nothing.
